summary: v46f DPR no-master workflow verified end-to-end, backend AND frontend. Backend pytest 6/6 (login → analyze-json TXT → create draft → save-as-master → list-verify country top-level → delete draft). Frontend Playwright: admin login → Tender Builder tab → open DPR modal → country dropdown lists platform countries (KZ, RU, UZ, GB, IN, …) → picking a country with no masters shows dpr-no-master-help amber box → both checkboxes (dpr-cross-country, dpr-no-master-mode) render correctly → borrow toggle populates dropdown with [COUNTRY] prefixed masters → no-master toggle disables the dropdown → uploading a small TXT DPR triggers analyze in ~4s → editable dpr-name-0 pre-filled from AI work_title ('Construction of 40km highway in Wales') → dpr-master-0 first option '— New master from this DPR —' → editing name to unique 'TEST_QA Wales Highway 1790163387' + CREATE → toast 'Created 1 AI draft (saved as new master)' → draft opens in Tender Builder → search box (tb-filter-q) filters to the new draft → Master Library sidebar shows the new '· RU master' entry immediately. Backend list confirms is_master=true with top-level country='RU' (or 'GB' from pytest). Cleanup done for drafts; masters remain (API-by-design).

issues: React console warning: 'value prop on select should not be null' — dpr-master-0 <select> receives value={p.masterId} where masterId is null when noMasterMode; wrap with `value={p.masterId || ''}`.
One legacy master shows up as '[??] Standard PSU e-Tender (GFR 2017, QCBS 70/30)' in cross-country dropdown because it has no country field — pre-existing seed, cosmetic only.
Persistent hydration warnings <span> inside <option> and <button> inside <button> (pre-existing since iteration_22, not related to v46f).

action_items: LOW: In DprGenerateModal.jsx around line 275, change `value={p.masterId}` to `value={p.masterId || ''}` on the dpr-master-{idx} select to silence the null-value React warning.
LOW (optional cleanup): Backfill the legacy seed master 'Standard PSU e-Tender (GFR 2017, QCBS 70/30)' with country='IN' so it no longer displays '[??]' in cross-country picker.
critical_code_review_comments: Save-as-master flow in cloneAndApply awaits saveAsMaster INSIDE the per-file loop but only surfaces errors via `errors.push` — the created draft (is_master=false) remains behind if saveAsMaster fails, so admin sees a draft AND a partial state. Consider deleting the draft on saveAsMaster failure, or unifying create+promote into one server-side endpoint.

cloneAndApply calls onCloned(created[0]) which opens the DRAFT in the builder, not the newly saved MASTER. If noMasterMode is on, the master lives as a separate document in the sidebar — users may confusingly edit the draft copy assuming they're editing the master. Consider opening the master doc when noMasterMode=true.
tender_pro.save_as_master duplicates every section including large HTML bodies; for a DPR with many sections this doubles storage on every use. Fine for now but flag if catalog scales.
DprGenerateModal auto-computes EMD inside cloneAndApply — swallows all errors silently (`try {} catch {}` on line 122). Reviewer won't know why EMD didn't fill. Add a toast.info in the catch.

The country dropdown in Country=1 uses publicApi.countries() (v46d) but if that endpoint returns empty, the modal offers only '— All countries —' and every attempt bricks with no visible error — verified live it works, but add a defensive toast on empty list.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — full happy path verified with real LLM call
